claims.text: Memantine: start 5 mg once daily, then raise in 5 mg steps to 20 mg/day (10 mg twice daily).
claims.quote: The recommended starting dose of memantine hydrochloride is 5 mg once daily. The dose should be increased in 5 mg increments to 10 mg/day (5 mg twice daily), 15 mg/day (5 mg and 10 mg as separate doses), and 20 mg/day (10 mg twice daily).

claims.text: Severe renal impairment (CrCl 5 to 29 mL/min): target 5 mg twice daily.
claims.quote: A target dose of 5 mg twice daily is recommended in patients with severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance of 5 to 29 mL/min based on the Cockcroft-Gault equation).

claims.text: Alkaline urine (pH 8) cut memantine clearance by about 80%, so urine-alkalinizing drugs or diet may cause accumulation and more adverse effects.
claims.quote: The clearance of memantine was reduced by about 80% under alkaline urine conditions at pH 8. Therefore, alterations of urine pH towards the alkaline condition may lead to an accumulation of the drug with a possible increase in adverse effects.
claims.locator: 7.1 Drugs that Make the Urine Alkaline

claims.text: Use other NMDA antagonists (amantadine, ketamine, dextromethorphan) with caution.
claims.quote: The combined use of memantine hydrochloride with other NMDA antagonists (amantadine, ketamine, and dextromethorphan) has not been systematically evaluated and such use should be approached with caution.
